purpose: Read and modify PowerPoint decks while preserving structure and visuals.

trigger: Create a PowerPoint deck from this outline
Inspect layout and speaker notes in the uploaded PPTX
Correct slides in the existing presentation using its template
do_not_trigger: Write a LaTeX math proof only
Publish a slide deck publicly without permission

preflight: Verify ownership, source deck, template/license and exact output path.
Preserve a copy of original slides and inspect layout restrictions.
workflow: Extract slide content, notes, dimensions and layout structure.
Edit or create deck according to approved structure and style.
Render slides and visually inspect overlaps, typography and images.
Verify produced PPTX opens and notes/media are preserved.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record slide count, aspect ratio, master/template and source revision.
Check exact file output and structural integrity after save.
Inspect rendered slides for cropping, overflow and alignment defects.

failure_modes: Do not assume syntactic PPTX validity proves visual correctness.
On missing fonts/masters, preserve original and disclose rendering difference.
